content.comment_body: I am attempting to get authorization to download [product_name]. I registered an account and submitted an application. After a day, my request was denied due to issues with my address, although no specific details were provided—just that the address was incorrect. My location is rural, and abbreviations like 'RR' for 'Range Road' are standard. I changed '51565 RR 223' to '51565 Range Road 223' and tried again. Today, my request was rejected based on my email address being 'from a company.' Is this simply because my email isn't a gmail or hotmail address? I've used my own domain for 25 years for personal email. I am not representing a company. I'm following the rules; I'm not exporting software illegally or infringing IP. I simply want to interact with a [product_name] I own. The process for downloading software feels unreasonably difficult.

Forum users are not able to directly address your situation. You can use the 'Suggestion' button on your post to contact the moderators, or you may want to submit a Support Request for further assistance. Unfortunately, that's all the support I can offer.
Alternatively, you can purchase a CD with license order number [article_no], which should resolve your issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters several unclear and seemingly arbitrary obstacles when attempting to download and license [product_name]. Account rejection is based on non-transparent criteria such as address formatting and email domain. The opaque process creates significant frustration and makes obtaining access to the software feel unnecessarily restrictive.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple, transparent, and fair download and licensing procedure for [product_name], without subjective limitations related to address format or email domain. Fast access to the software for private use is desired.
